rfm_tuples.R: Our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer have concluded that, as a result of the material weaknesses in our internal control, our disclosure controls and procedures were not effective as of December 31, 2023.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: confirm via Item 9A and auditor attestation. Mode B: derive that disclosure-control failure typically precedes restatement and/or non-reliance 8-K; check EDGAR list_filings for NT 10-K and Item 4.02 8-K.
rfm_tuples.M_value: Item 9A explicitly states DC&P 'were not effective.' EDGAR confirms NT 10-K filed 2024-03-01 (Form 12b-25) and NT 10-Q filed 2023-11-13 — TWO late-filing notices in a 4-month window. 10-K body further admits 'subsequent to the filing of the Notification of Late Filing on Form 12b-25 ... we made adjustments to certain line items in our financial statements as of and for the year ended December 31, 2023.' Q1 2024 10-Q (filed 2024-05-08) re-affirms DC&P remained ineffective as of 2024-03-31 — no remediation progress in one quarter.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Two NT filings, COSO control-environment and control-activities material weaknesses, post-12b-25 financial-statement adjustments, and ineffective DC&P sustained into Q1-2024 = textbook governance distress for a sub-$200M-rev small-cap. Big-4 audit (Deloitte) issued adverse ICFR opinion. Mode B addition (NT 10-Q in Nov-2023 + post-NT adjustments to FY23 line items) is more damning than the headline language.

rfm_tuples.R: The Company does not have a sufficient number of qualified resources within our accounting and IT function with the appropriate level of technical accounting or other requisite knowledge ... We currently do not have an internal audit group.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: confirm via Item 9A. Mode B: a public diagnostics company with $193M revenue, China subsidiary (Wuxi), Hong Kong subsidiary, related-party investment activity and a $50M buyback program operating without an internal audit function is implausibly under-resourced for the complexity it carries — derive that a Q4-2024 or FY-2024 additional weakness or restatement is a non-trivial probability.
rfm_tuples.M_source: 10-K Item 9A; related-party note 23 (Tianjin Deep Analysis investment)
rfm_tuples.M_value: Item 9A explicitly admits no internal audit group and inadequate GITCs over access security; Note 23 discloses related-party investments via Cytek HK (Tianjin Deep Analysis); intercompany transaction issues already cited as having delayed the Q3-2023 close.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Mode B finding: complexity (multi-jurisdiction subs, related-party investments, $44M buyback, IPO-era accounting) outpaces the finance function. The remediation plan is forward-looking aspirational language ('we are committed', 'we will continue') with zero confirmed hires, zero new controls operating effectively, and zero internal audit function.

rfm_tuples.R: On May 17, 2023, the Board approved a program for the repurchase of up to an aggregate of $50 million of our outstanding common stock. ... we repurchased ... a total cost of approximately $44.0 million at an average price per share of $6.66.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: confirm via 10-K Item 5 and cash-flow statement. Mode B: cross-check against FY23 operating result and cash trajectory — does a profitable, cash-generating business buy back $44M, or is this capital-return signaling masking a cash burn?
rfm_tuples.M_value: Cash and equivalents fell from $299.5M (Dec-31-2022) to $167.6M (Dec-31-2023) = $131.9M decline. The 10-K attributes $44.2M to buybacks, but operating cash provided was only $5.3M and the company swung from net income $2.5M (2022) to net loss $12.1M (2023). Loss from operations was $(27.8)M in 2023 vs $(1.8)M in 2022 — a 15x deterioration in operating losses in the SAME year as the buyback authorization.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Mode B catch: the buyback was authorized in May 2023 when management presumably knew Q1 trends; by Q3 they could not close the books on time (NT 10-Q Nov-13-2023); by year-end operating losses had ballooned to ~$28M. Returning $44M to shareholders at $6.66 average while operating losses widened 15x and the close process was breaking down is either capital-allocation malpractice or a price-support signal. Either way it is not a strong-fundamentals action.

rfm_tuples.R: On November 10, 2023, Wenbin Jiang, our Chief Executive Officer, President and Chairman of the Board of Directors, terminated his written plan that was intended to satisfy the affirmative defense conditions of Rule 10b5-1(c). The Plan was set to expire on January 31, 2024 and covered the sale of a total of 1,200,000 shares.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: confirm via Item 9B 10b5-1 disclosure. Mode B: timing context — November 10, 2023 is 3 days before the NT 10-Q (Nov-13) and a month before fiscal year-end during a material-weakness period. A CEO terminating an active sale plan immediately before a known-bad disclosure is a behavior pattern worth examining.
rfm_tuples.M_value: EDGAR confirms 8-K dated 2023-11-09 (one day before plan termination), NT 10-Q filed 2023-11-13 (three days after termination), and 10-Q itself filed 2023-11-14. The plan covering 1.2M shares (set to run until Jan-31-2024) was killed at the exact pre-disclosure window.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Mode B finding. Termination of a 10b5-1 plan immediately before non-public adverse-disclosure events (NT 10-Q, material-weakness identification continuing into year-end) is a defensible-but-suggestive insider behavior pattern. No purchases reported; no plan adoption since. Combined with C3 (company buying $44M of stock), this is asymmetric: company buys, CEO refrains from selling.

rfm_tuples.R: Total revenue for the year ended December 31, 2023 was $193.0 million, representing a 18% increase compared to revenue for the year ended December 31, 2022 of $164.0 million.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: confirm in income statement. Mode B: examine quality of growth — service vs product mix, distributor share, China/APAC exposure, and YoY trajectory vs operating leverage promise.
rfm_tuples.M_source: 10-K MD&A and consolidated statements of operations; Note 22 geographic areas
rfm_tuples.M_value: Product revenue $156.7M (2023) vs $148.6M (2022) = +5% only. Service revenue $36.3M vs $15.4M = +135% (largely the acquired FCI service business). APAC revenue $31.6M (16% of total) and includes Wuxi-made instruments. Distributor channel revenue was 24%/21%/14% of total in 2023/2022/2021 — growing distributor dependence. Loss from operations widened from $(1.8)M to $(27.8)M despite +18% revenue (negative operating leverage).
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Headline revenue growth is misleading. Product revenue (the core instrument franchise) grew only 5%, well below the 18% headline; the +18% is propped up by ~$21M of acquired service revenue (FCI). Negative operating leverage at +18% revenue (operating loss 15x worse YoY) signals fixed-cost bloat. Mode B: a growth diagnostics story with decelerating product growth, increasing distributor reliance, and worsening operating losses does not look like a company entering an inflection — it looks like a 2021-vintage growth story that has stalled.

rfm_tuples.R: Based on our current planned operations, we expect that our existing cash will enable us to fund our operating expenses for at least 12 months from the date hereof.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: confirm in MD&A liquidity section. Mode B: compute implied runway honestly given FY23 operating-loss run-rate, ongoing buyback authorization, and cash trajectory.
rfm_tuples.M_source: 10-K MD&A liquidity, balance sheet, cash-flow statement
rfm_tuples.M_value: Year-end 2023 cash $167.6M + ST investments + marketable securities → ~$268M total liquid resources. FY23 net cash used by all activities = $(131.9)M decline. Stripping the $44M buyback and ~$30M acquisition spend, organic burn was modest (operating activities actually provided $5.3M). At the FY23 operating-loss run-rate of $(27.8)M and capex, raw runway is multi-year, BUT only if buybacks stop and operating-loss trajectory does not worsen. Q1-2024 (10-Q filed 2024-05-08) shows cash steady at $168.8M = good intra-quarter discipline.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: 12-month going-concern claim looks defensible based on the disclosure alone — large IPO cash pile remains, Q1-2024 cash held flat, buyback program expired Dec-31-2023. This is the only PASS in the tuple set.

rfm_tuples.R: For the year ended December 31, 2023 and 2022, the Company had no major customers.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: confirm in Note 22 / revenue concentration footnote.
rfm_tuples.M_source: 10-K Note 22 Geographic areas + revenue mix disclosures
rfm_tuples.M_value: Confirmed in Note 22. Customer mix shows Academia/government $82M, Biotech/pharma/CRO/distributor $111M. No single >10% customer disclosed. Direct vs distributor split disclosed (76% direct in 2023).
rfm_tuples.interpretation: No customer-concentration red flag at the 10% threshold. Distributor channel share is growing (14%→21%→24%) which is a different exposure but not customer concentration.

rfm_tuples.R: Deloitte & Touche LLP, our independent registered public accounting firm, has audited the effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2023 and has issued an attestation report on our internal controls over financial reporting.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: confirm Deloitte tenure and read the attestation opinion (qualified/unqualified on FS, qualified/unqualified on ICFR).
rfm_tuples.M_value: Deloitte issued (a) an UNQUALIFIED opinion on the FY23 financial statements but (b) an ADVERSE opinion on ICFR ('because of the effect of the material weaknesses identified ... the Company has not maintained effective internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2023'). Deloitte tenure is multi-year ('We have served as the Company's auditor since ...').
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Big-4 auditor giving an adverse ICFR opinion is the strongest possible negative external signal short of a going-concern qualification or auditor resignation. The clean FS opinion is reassuring but the ICFR adverse opinion is the part that drives forward risk of restatement.

supplemental_signals.filings_velocity: Two late-filing notifications (NT 10-Q 2023-11-13; NT 10-K 2024-03-01) in 4 months. Post-NT-10-K financial statement adjustments admitted in MD&A.
supplemental_signals.auditor_quality: Deloitte & Touche LLP (Big 4) — POSITIVE on credibility, but issued ADVERSE ICFR opinion — NEGATIVE on substance.
supplemental_signals.insider_capital_asymmetry: Company repurchased $44M of stock at avg $6.66 during FY23 while operating loss widened 15x YoY; CEO terminated 1.2M-share 10b5-1 plan on 2023-11-10, days before NT 10-Q.
supplemental_signals.china_exposure: APAC = 16% of revenue; manufacturing in Wuxi, China; related-party investment via Cytek HK in Tianjin Deep Analysis. Geopolitical / BIOSECURE-style risk exists at cutoff date but is not the dominant risk driver here.
supplemental_signals.competitive_position: Competes vs Beckman/Danaher, BD, Bio-Rad, Standard BioTools, Miltenyi, Sony, Thermo Fisher — Tier-1 large-cap competitors. Settled 2018 BD trade-secret/IP litigation in Oct-2020 with patent license; ongoing royalty obligation to BD.
supplemental_signals.growth_quality: Headline +18% revenue (FY23) inflated by FCI service-revenue acquisition (+135% service growth); core product revenue grew only +5%. Q1-2024 revenue +21% YoY but still material weaknesses unremediated.
supplemental_signals.honesty_assessment: Disclosure quality is fully candid — material weaknesses, ineffective DC&P, NT filings, late-filed adjustments, adverse ICFR opinion all explicitly stated. This is an HONEST distressed disclosure, not a concealment. Mode B catches (buyback timing vs operating-loss expansion, 10b5-1 termination timing, NT-10-Q-then-restatement-of-NT-10-K sequence, complexity outpacing finance team) are forensic-context findings, not lying-detector findings.

summary: CTKB carries an adverse ICFR opinion from Deloitte, material weaknesses in control environment and control activities, no internal audit function, and filed Form 12b-25 notifications for both the Q3-2023 10-Q AND the FY-2023 10-K — with admitted post-NT financial-statement adjustments. Operating loss widened 15x YoY ($(1.8)M→$(27.8)M) on +18% revenue (only +5% core product growth; growth is acquired service revenue). Concurrently, the company executed $44M of buybacks at $6.66 avg while burning $132M of cash, and the CEO terminated a 1.2M-share 10b5-1 sale plan three days before the NT 10-Q. Disclosure is candid (not concealment), but the substance is distressed-governance + decelerating core franchise + capital-allocation asymmetry. Liquidity is genuinely strong ($268M total liquid resources) so this is not a going-concern story; it is a control-failure + stalled-growth + capital-misallocation story with insider behavior worth flagging.
